data.title: Garofalo Health Care: Buy Rating Reaffirmed as Operational Efficiency and M&A Upside Support Unchanged Target Price
data.description:
Emanuele Gallazzi, an analyst from Equita Sim, maintained the Buy rating on Garofalo Health Care S.P.A.. The associated price target is €6.20.

Emanuele Gallazzi has given his Buy rating due to a combination of factors tied to both operating trends and valuation. Garofalo Health Care delivered second‑quarter results broadly in line with expectations, with revenues and adjusted EBITDA slightly ahead of forecasts and a clear improvement in profitability in the Rome operations, confirming the success of efficiency measures and the strategic reorganization underway.

At the same time, the downgrade to earnings mainly reflects more conservative, largely non‑cash provisions linked to the Gelli Law rather than a deterioration in the core business. Management has reiterated 2026 guidance, highlighted near‑term accretive M&A opportunities, and is accelerating investment in key facilities, while the shares still trade at attractive EV/EBITDA multiples relative to their defensive profile and sizable owned real‑estate portfolio, supporting upside to the unchanged target price.
